name: Schafberg from St. Wolfgang
why: Up from the lake on foot to a summit hotel on a cliff edge, with three lakes of the Salzkammergut in one view; the old cog railway takes you down.
book: Free on foot; Schafbergbahn cog railway (May to October) for one way.
dangers: Steep final section with steps and cables.

points.name: St. Wolfgang
points.note: A lakeside village with a pilgrim church.

points.name: Schafberg
points.note: The 1,783 m summit and its hotel above the Mondsee.
